place.part: Part IV - Glossary and Semantics (rxjs.dev/guide/glossary-and-semantics)

tools.definition: The producer reporting a problem and announcing it will send no more values and will finalize; not after complete, another error, or unsubscription.

place.part: Part IV - Glossary and Semantics (rxjs.dev/guide/glossary-and-semantics)

tools.title: Complete (action)
tools.definition: The producer announcing it is done without error and will finalize; never after error or unsubscribe, never twice, always before finalization.

place.part: Part IV - Glossary and Semantics (rxjs.dev/guide/glossary-and-semantics)

place.part: Part IV - Glossary and Semantics (rxjs.dev/guide/glossary-and-semantics)

analog.clause: Use the smallest worker concurrency that meets the workload before accepting added coordination cost.
